opts: 中国书法是用软笔和黑墨书写的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Many young artists are painting colourful pictures on the old wall.

listeningQuestions.audio: Han Gan learned to paint horses by watching real ones.
opts: 韩干通过观察真马学会了画马。

reading.passage: In a small studio by the river, an old sculptor is making a stone horse. At the moment, its legs are being carved with great care, and bits of stone cover the floor. Many visitors come to watch, sure that the finished horse will look ready to gallop away.
reading.passageCn: 在河边一间小工作室里,一位老雕塑家正在做一匹石马。此刻马腿正被精心雕琢,石屑铺满地面。许多人前来观看,坚信完成后的马看起来仿佛要飞奔而去。

questions.q: What is the sculptor doing at the moment?
opts: Carving the legs of a stone horse.
Painting a picture of a horse.

questions.q: What do the visitors believe about the finished horse?
opts: It will look ready to run away.
It will be too small to see.
It will soon be sold abroad.

writing.prompt: Write a short article about an artwork you like. Say what it is, who made it, and how you feel about it. Try to use 'is/are being displayed'.
writing.promptCn: 写一段你喜欢的艺术作品介绍:是什么、谁创作的、你的感受(试着用 is/are being displayed)。

lines.text: Which work in this exhibition do you like most?
lines.cn: 这个展览里你最喜欢哪件作品?

lines.text: The stone horse. Look — it is being protected by glass right now.
lines.cn: 那匹石马。看,它此刻正被玻璃罩保护着。

lines.text: Why do you like it so much?
Because the sculptor caught the animal's wild spirit so well.
lines.cn: 因为雕塑家把这匹马狂野的神韵抓得太好了。

lines.text: Do you think art is only found in museums?
lines.cn: 你觉得艺术只能在博物馆里找到吗?

lines.text: No, art is everywhere. Look at the pictures being painted on that wall.
lines.cn: 不,艺术无处不在。看那面墙上正在画的画。

lines.text: You're right. Even the trees are being trimmed into lovely shapes.
lines.cn: 你说得对。连树也正被修剪成漂亮的形状。

lines.text: Exactly. Great art can be found in our own neighbourhood.
lines.cn: 正是。伟大的艺术就在我们自己的社区里。
